title: Addon Manager Lifecycle Automation
problem: Nako proved the manual addon loop but lacked a built-in Addon Manager registry/plan slot. This lane delivered the first redaction-safe manager plan surface for addon registration detail, health, tokens, grants, install guide output, and operator-confirmed install/update/remove intent while splitting marketplace hosting, package signing, provider breadth, rollback execution, and direct process/container supervision to follow-ons.

evidence.summary: Lane opened after the official addon alpha loop was proven with published Nako surfaces, public Addon Protocol crates, and the crates.io-distributed metadata scraper smoke path.

First manager slice narrowed to addon source discovery, permissions, token rotation, Addon Health Check visibility, and Addon Install Guide behavior; direct process/container supervision split to follow-on.

Added the first manager-owned registry/plan snapshot surface as GET /admin/v1/addons/{addon_id}/manager-plan, combining registration, health, tokens, grants, and install guide without process/container supervision.

Added operator-confirmed POST /admin/v1/addons/{addon_id}/manager-plan lifecycle intents for install, update, and remove; validated with focused addon tests and the repeatable official-addon-e2e smoke against a current-source image.

Closed the lane after fresh cargo fmt, server addon nextest, nako-api test compile, and official addon e2e smoke gates passed; split marketplace, package signing, provider breadth, rollback/update execution, and process/container supervision into follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: The first manager-owned registry/plan slot is complete. Open separate follow-on lanes for marketplace/source catalogs, package signing, provider breadth, rollback/update execution, or direct process/container supervision.
